name: BazarDor — বাজার দর
description: A responsive Bangla market-price tracking application that helps users explore daily prices of essential products and compare prices across local markets.
features: Explore daily essential prices in Bangla, with price increases and decreases clearly marked.
Browse products by category and sort them by price.
View market-wise minimum, maximum, and average prices for each product.

name: FitLog — Workout Library
description: A responsive workout library built with Next.js and TypeScript that helps users explore exercises, build daily workout plans, save workouts, and track completed exercises.
features: Browse, search, sort, and filter workouts with detailed step-by-step instructions.
Build a daily workout plan with a five-exercise limit and save favorites with persistent storage.
Track completed exercises and view workout statistics.

name: Simplico
description: A modern and responsive React application that showcases popular mobile applications in an App Store-style interface.
features: Search and explore popular mobile applications.
View detailed information for individual applications.
Install and manage applications with interactive charts.

name: Customer Support Zone
description: A responsive React application for managing customer support tickets through an interactive workflow.
features: Manage and assign customer support tickets.
Track in-progress and resolved tickets in real time.
Complete tasks with duplicate-assignment prevention.

name: Champions League Dream Team
description: A responsive React application where users build their own dream cricket team by selecting players within a limited coin budget.
features: Purchase players within a limited coin balance in real time.
Prevent duplicate selections with a 6-player team limit.
Toggle between available and selected players with instant notifications.

name: Green Earth
description: A responsive web application that allows users to explore plants, filter them by categories, and view detailed plant information through a modern API-driven interface.
features: Load and filter plant data dynamically from an open API.
View detailed plant information in an interactive modal.
Add plants to a cart with real-time total price calculation.

name: Emergency Service Directory
description: A responsive web application providing instant access to emergency hotline numbers, with one-click copy, mock call functionality, and live call history tracking.
features: Copy hotline numbers directly to clipboard with a live counter.
Simulate emergency calls using a coin-based usage system.
Track every call made in a dynamic, clearable history log.

name: PAYOO — Smart MFS Interface
description: A smart Mobile Financial Services interface delivering a seamless digital banking experience for managing money transfers and transactions.
features: Add money, cash out, and transfer funds with PIN-based authentication.
Earn and track promotional cashbacks and bonus rewards.
Browse a paginated, filterable transaction history log.
